title.en: Why social science, and time zones

text.en:
Meena's cousin in London said it was morning there while it was afternoon in India.
"Why is the time different?" asked Meena.

Social science studies people and how they live together. It includes history, geography, political science and economics, and helps us understand our society and its past.
Coordinates of latitude and longitude help us fix any place on a map. The Earth turns, so when it is day in one place it is night in another.
Time zones divide the world so that clocks match the Sun. India uses one time, Indian Standard Time, which is 5 hours 30 minutes ahead of Greenwich.
